brokers.name: Zerodha (Kite + Coin)
brokers.tagline: Stocks & ETFs on Kite, zero-commission direct mutual funds on Coin.
account: Sign up at zerodha.com with your PAN, Aadhaar and bank details.
Finish the online KYC (Aadhaar OTP e-sign) — usually approved in a day.
Add funds to your trading account from your linked bank.
Use Kite for stocks/ETFs and Coin (coin.zerodha.com) for mutual fund SIPs.

assetHowTo.equity: On Kite, search the stock, place a buy order, and use a GTT or a monthly reminder to repeat — direct equity has no true auto-SIP.
assetHowTo.largecapMF: On Coin, open the direct-growth plan and tap 'Start SIP' with your date and amount.
assetHowTo.midSmallMF: Same as above on Coin — pick the direct-growth plan and set a monthly SIP.
assetHowTo.elss: On Coin, start a SIP in a direct ELSS fund; each instalment locks in for 3 years.
assetHowTo.indexETF: Buy the ETF on Kite; set a monthly GTT or calendar reminder (ETFs can't auto-SIP on Coin).
assetHowTo.sectorETF: Buy on Kite the same way as an index ETF — manual monthly buy or GTT.
assetHowTo.debtMF: On Coin, start a SIP in a direct debt fund of the chosen category.
assetHowTo.govtBonds: Buy G-Secs/SGBs via Kite's Bonds/Government Securities section during RBI windows.
assetHowTo.digitalGold: Use Gold ETFs or Sovereign Gold Bonds on Kite — Zerodha doesn't sell MMTC digital gold.
assetHowTo.digitalSilver: Buy a Silver ETF on Kite and repeat monthly.
assetHowTo.reits: REITs trade like shares — buy the units on Kite and repeat monthly.

brokers.name: Groww
brokers.tagline: Stocks, ETFs and direct mutual funds in one simple app.
account: Download Groww or open groww.in and sign up with your email and phone.
Enter PAN and complete the in-app KYC (Aadhaar + selfie).
Link and verify your bank account.
Search any fund, stock or ETF and invest from the same dashboard.

assetHowTo.equity: Search the stock and buy; set a personal monthly reminder, as direct shares have no auto-SIP.
assetHowTo.largecapMF: Open the direct plan, tap 'Start SIP', set amount and date — Groww auto-debits via mandate.
assetHowTo.midSmallMF: Same flow — choose the direct-growth plan and start a monthly SIP.
assetHowTo.elss: Start a SIP in a direct ELSS fund; remember each instalment is locked for 3 years.
assetHowTo.indexETF: Buy the ETF from the Stocks/ETF tab; repeat monthly (no auto-SIP for ETFs).
assetHowTo.sectorETF: Buy from the ETF section and repeat monthly.
assetHowTo.debtMF: Start a SIP in a direct debt fund just like an equity fund.
assetHowTo.govtBonds: Use Groww's Bonds section for G-Secs/SGBs where available.
assetHowTo.digitalGold: Groww offers digital gold — buy a fixed rupee amount monthly, or use a Gold ETF.
assetHowTo.digitalSilver: Buy a Silver ETF from the ETF section monthly.
assetHowTo.reits: Buy listed REIT units from the Stocks tab and repeat monthly.

brokers.name: Kuvera
brokers.tagline: 100% commission-free direct mutual funds, digital gold, no stock noise.
account: Sign up at kuvera.in or the Kuvera app with your email.
Complete KYC online (PAN + Aadhaar); existing KYC is auto-fetched.
Link your bank and set up an auto-pay mandate for SIPs.
Invest only in direct mutual funds and digital gold — Kuvera has no brokerage/stocks.

assetHowTo.equity: Not supported — Kuvera has no stock trading. Use a large-cap index fund as a proxy, or buy shares on a broker.
assetHowTo.largecapMF: Search the direct plan, set a SIP amount and date; the mandate auto-debits.
assetHowTo.midSmallMF: Same flow — pick the direct-growth plan and start a monthly SIP.
assetHowTo.elss: Start a SIP in a direct ELSS fund; each instalment locks for 3 years.
assetHowTo.indexETF: Kuvera offers index funds rather than ETFs — use the equivalent direct index fund SIP.
assetHowTo.sectorETF: Use a thematic/sector index fund SIP, as ETFs aren't traded here.
assetHowTo.debtMF: Start a SIP in a direct debt fund of the chosen category.
assetHowTo.govtBonds: Use a Gilt/G-Sec direct fund SIP as the closest no-broker option.
assetHowTo.digitalGold: Kuvera offers digital gold (Augmont) — buy a fixed amount monthly.
assetHowTo.digitalSilver: Use a Silver fund-of-fund SIP if available; otherwise a Silver ETF on a broker.
assetHowTo.reits: Not supported directly — REITs need a broking account.

brokers.name: MF Central / AMC direct
brokers.tagline: Buy straight from the fund houses — lowest cost, a bit more manual.
account: Register at mfcentral.com (run jointly by CAMS & KFintech) with PAN and email.
Verify with the OTP sent to your registered mobile/email.
Your existing folios across all AMCs appear in one place.
Start SIPs scheme-by-scheme, or invest directly on each AMC's own website.

assetHowTo.equity: Not available — direct stocks need a demat/broking account.
assetHowTo.largecapMF: Start a direct-plan SIP on the AMC site or via MF Central's transact flow.
assetHowTo.midSmallMF: Same — pick the direct-growth plan on the AMC website and set a SIP.
assetHowTo.elss: Start a direct ELSS SIP on the AMC site; each instalment locks for 3 years.
assetHowTo.indexETF: Use the AMC's direct index fund SIP (ETFs need a demat account).
assetHowTo.sectorETF: Use the AMC's direct thematic/sector index fund SIP.
assetHowTo.debtMF: Start a direct debt fund SIP on the AMC website or MF Central.
assetHowTo.govtBonds: Buy SGBs via RBI Retail Direct (rbiretaildirect.org.in) or a Gilt direct fund.
assetHowTo.digitalGold: Use a Gold fund-of-fund direct SIP, or SGBs via RBI Retail Direct.
assetHowTo.digitalSilver: Use a Silver fund-of-fund direct SIP from the AMC.
assetHowTo.reits: Not available without a demat/broking account.
